messages.content: How many people play Roblox right now? Give me the latest numbers.

Latest official numbers are from Roblox's **Q2 2026** shareholder letter (quarter ended Jun 30, 2026):

- **123M daily active users** on average, +10% YoY [P]
- **29B hours** engaged, +5% YoY [P]
- **$1,557M bookings**, +8% YoY [P]
- **27M monthly unique payers**, +15% YoY [P]

Source: Q2 2026 letter (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001315098/000162828026051059/ex991-robloxq22026earnin.htm).

Two caveats:
1. **Q3 2026 results come out Oct 29, 2026.** If today is after that, check ir.roblox.com for newer figures.
2. DAU peaked at **151.5M in Q3 2025** during the viral wave (Grow a Garden, Steal a Brainrot), so 123M is down from the peak but up year over year [P] (Q3 2025 letter).

For a full year, 2025 averaged **127M DAU** and **123.9B hours** [P] (FY2025 10-K).
Someone on Discord says 18+ players are now the biggest group on Roblox. True?

Not under Roblox's current data.

Since Q1 2026 Roblox reports **age-checked** users (face estimate or ID) instead of self-reported ages. Roblox says the age-checked data shows a **younger** base than the old self-reported numbers.

Age-checked split, 7 days ended Jun 30, 2026 [P] (Q2 2026 letter):
- Under 13: **35%**
- 13–17: **38%**
- 18+: **27%**

So 18+ is the **smallest** of the three groups globally, and about 73% are under 18.

What *is* true: 18+ is the **fastest-growing** group in the **US**. US 18+ DAU is +32% YoY and US 18–34 is +42%. 18+ is about a third of US age-checked DAU, and US 18+ players monetize 50%+ more than under-18s [P].

Caveat: only **57%** of DAU had age-checked by end of Q2 2026, so the split can still move.
What's the difference between bookings and revenue in Roblox's reports? Which one should I look at?

- **Bookings** = the value of Robux (and subscriptions) players bought in the period. It's the closest thing to "what players spent this quarter".
- **Revenue** = bookings recognised over the estimated time players keep using what they bought, so it **lags** bookings.

Example, Q2 2026 [P] (Q2 2026 letter): bookings **$1,557M (+8%)**, revenue **$1,469M (+36%)**. Revenue grew faster because it still includes 2025's huge bookings being recognised later.

For "is player spending going up or down right now", use **bookings**. Here bookings are softening: Q3 2026 is guided at $1,576–1,653M, **−14% to −18% YoY** [P].
Is Roblox growing or shrinking in 2026? Be honest.

Both, depending on the metric (as of Oct 2026).

**Growing (YoY, Q2 2026)** [P]:
- DAU 123M (+10%)
- Hours 29B (+5%)
- Payers 27M (+15%)
- Revenue +36%

**Shrinking or slowing** [P]:
- Bookings grew only +8% in Q2, and Q3 2026 is **guided down 14–18% YoY**. That's Roblox's first guided bookings decline.
- Compared with the Q3 2025 peak (151.5M DAU, 39.6B hours), engagement is lower.

**Why, in Roblox's words** (Q1 and Q2 2026 letters):
1. Mandatory **age checks for chat** cut on-platform chat.
2. Players shifted from 2025's high-spending viral hits to games that earn less per hour.
3. The new **Recommended For You** algorithm deliberately favours retention over near-term spend.

Good sign for small devs: the top 10 games took ~20% of hours in Q2 2026, down from ~30% three years earlier. Games outside the top 10 grew hours +25% [P].

Re-check after the Oct 29, 2026 Q3 report.
How much does Roblox pay creators in total?

- **FY2025 DevEx fees: $1,503M**, up from $923M in 2024 [P] (Q4 2025 letter, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1315098/000131509826000009/ex991-q42025shareholder.htm)
- **~$1.7B** earned by creators in the 12 months to Jun 30, 2026 [P] (RDC 2026)
- **$5B+** paid via DevEx since 2013 [P] (RDC 2026)
- Q2 2026 alone: **$363M**, +15% YoY [P]

It's very concentrated:
- **23,500+** creators were paid cash in 2025, out of **35,500+** registered [P] (FY2025 10-K).
- The **top 1,000** averaged **$1.3M** each in 2025 [P].
- Roughly speaking (my calculation), the top 1,000 got most of the total. Median creator earnings aren't published.
Can I use Roblox's $0.15 bookings per DAU as my game's ARPDAU target?

No, it's the wrong comparison.

**$0.15 average daily bookings per DAU** (FY2025 10-K [P]) is **platform-wide**: everything a Roblox user buys in a day, across every game, avatar items and Premium/Plus.

Your game's ARPDAU is different in three ways:
- A Roblox DAU spends ~2.6–2.7 hours a day across **several** games, not just yours.
- You keep about **70%** of the Robux spent on passes and dev products [S].
- You cash out at **$0.0038 per Robux** [P], so you net about **26.6%** of what the player paid (calc: 0.70 × 0.0038 ÷ 0.01).

Roblox publishes **no per-game ARPDAU benchmark**. Use your own Creator Hub monetization dashboard over 28 days. Compare against your own last month, and against your benchmark peer group in the dashboard if one is shown.
Where are Roblox players from, and where's the money?

From the FY2025 10-K [P]:
- **~82% of DAUs** are **outside** the US & Canada.
- Only **~39% of revenue** is from outside the US & Canada.

So US/Canada is about **18% of players but ~61% of revenue** (my calculation).

Growth is international. Q2 2026 DAU: **Japan +67%**, **India +64%**, US/Canada **+6%** [P] (Q2 2026 letter). Payers outside US/Canada grew +23%.

What to do:
- Design UI that needs no English (icons, colour, motion).
- Keep **regional pricing** on. Roblox's 2025 data: +4–10% Robux spend and +43–52% pass purchases in discounted regions [P].
- Don't judge success only by Robux. A big international audience still feeds retention signals that drive discovery.
What are the concurrent-player records on Roblox?

Records reported by Roblox [P]:
- **Platform: 45M+ concurrent users**, Aug 23, 2025 (Q3 2025 letter)
- **Steal a Brainrot: 25M+** concurrent (Q3/Q4 2025 letters)
- **Grow a Garden: "nearly 22M"** (Q3 2025 letter)

The exact Grow a Garden peak of **22,346,725** (Aug 2025) comes from community trackers [U]. Earlier 21.3–21.6M marks were reported by PocketGamer.biz [S].

For context, a Monday-evening snapshot on Oct 26, 2026 (Roblox charts API) had the top game at ~744k players. Records are weekend/update spikes, not normal days.
Quick: what share of Roblox players are on mobile?

Roblox doesn't publish an official device split in its 2025 10-K or 2026 letters.

Best available:
- **~80%** of users access Roblox on mobile [S] (Newzoo, Oct 2025)
- **24%** of players aged 10–65 play **only** on mobile [S] (same source)
- **44%** of FY2025 revenue came through the Apple (29%) and Google (15%) stores [P] (FY2025 10-K)

So most players touch Roblox on a phone, and many also play on PC/console. Build phone-first and test on PC. Treat "80%" as an analyst estimate of **access**, not playtime.
My TD game has 800 DAU. Is that good? The top games have hundreds of thousands.

Comparing to the top is the wrong yardstick. Use these instead:

1. **Retention vs your own past.** Roblox's discovery uses play days over **28 days** (D1, D2–7, D8–28) as a top signal [P] (Discovery docs). Signals are **averages per user**, so 800 loyal players can beat 8,000 who bounce.
2. **Chart thresholds.** *Top Revisited* and *Fun with Friends* need ≥5,000 daily users, top-10% DAU, or top-30 most played [P] (charts API). *Up-and-Coming* only takes games published in the last 28 days.
3. **The long tail is growing.** Games outside the top 10 grew hours +25% YoY in Q2 2026. The top 10's share fell to ~20% [P].

Next step: pull your D1 and D7 for the last 28 days and your first-play bounce (<60 s). If D7 is rising week over week, 800 DAU is a healthy base to grow from with a small ad test.
Write me a 5-line status note on the Roblox platform for my devlog, dated today (Oct 26, 2026).

**Roblox platform status, Oct 26, 2026** (latest official = Q2 2026)
1. 123M DAU (+10% YoY), 29B hours (+5%), $1.56B bookings (+8%) [P, Q2 2026 letter].
2. Q3 2026 bookings guided −14% to −18% YoY. Results due Oct 29, 2026 [P].
3. Age-checked players: 35% under 13, 38% 13–17, 27% 18+ (57% of DAU checked) [P].
4. Discovery now optimises 28-day retention. Top 10 games' share of hours fell to ~20% [P].
5. DevEx: $0.0038/Robux standard, $0.0054 for eligible US 18+ spend (since Jun 8, 2026) [P, DevEx docs].
A YouTuber says 'Roblox creators made $2 billion last quarter'. Can you check?

That doesn't match Roblox's reports.

- **Q2 2026 DevEx fees were $363M** [P] (Q2 2026 letter).
- The record quarter was **Q4 2025 at $477M** [P].
- **Full-year 2025 was $1,503M** [P].
- Roblox's RDC 2026 figure is **~$1.7B over 12 months** to Jun 30, 2026 [P].

The $2B may be mixing up **bookings** (what players spent: Q4 2025 was $2,222M) with **creator payouts**. Creators get roughly 22% of bookings as DevEx cash (calc: 2025 DevEx ÷ bookings).

Tag the YouTuber's claim **[U]** and cite the shareholder letter instead.
